theorems.statement: ∀ (K F : Type*) [Field K] [Field F] [Algebra K F] (x : F), Transcendental K x → (∀ f : F, ∃ a b : Polynomial K, b ≠ 0 ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b) → ∀ q : Polynomial K, q.Monic → Irreducible q → ∃ v : AlgebraicCurve.Place K F, (∀ f : F, f ∈ v.toValuationSubring ↔ ∃ a b : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ b ∧ f = Polynomial.aeval x a / Polynomial.aeval x b) ∧ v.deg = q.natDegree ∧ v.ord (Polynomial.aeval x q) = 1 ∧ (∀ a : Polynomial K, ¬ q ∣ a → v.ord (Polynomial.aeval x a) = 0)
